verdict.rationale: Productboard's core workflow explicitly supports converting feedback into features/initiatives: feedback can be linked to feature ideas automatically (docs-16), feedback API lets PMs associate feedback with features/components (docs-4, docs-17), and the MCP server lets agents create features/initiatives from context (docs-10, docs-12). This matches the feedback-to-task/intention story well as a first-party documented capability. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the 'automatic insight detection' claim and a concrete UI walkthrough showing a feedback item becoming a task end-to-end.
